title: Expand a greeting macro
description: You can follow a text macro from its definition to the program's printed greeting.

steps.description: The header supplies declarations for standard input and output. GREETING names the string literal used below.
main is the program's entry function. Its body contains the output call and return.

steps.question: What replaces GREETING before this call is compiled?
steps.answer: The preprocessor substitutes the defined greeting string literal.

steps.description: The greeting literal and newline form printf's text. The supplied run displays Hello, World! and then returns zero.
